designationHistory.name: Salt Meadow National Wildlife Refuge
designationHistory.indexText: Established in 1972 as Salt Meadow National Wildlife Refuge with a land donation in Westbrook, Connecticut; renamed for Congressman Stewart B. McKinney in 1987.

authority.citation: Land donation to the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service

designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Stewart B. McKinney National Wildlife Refuge, About Us
Wild Birds Unlimited Old Saybrook: Stewart B. McKinney NWR "was established in 1972 and was originally called Salt Meadow National Wildlife Refuge," renamed in 1987
Connecticut Explored: refuge began "with a single land donation in 1972"; Salt Meadow Unit was the first property; named for McKinney in 1987

review.note: Year and earlier name confirmed by two non-FWS sources (both secondary).
